target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
target_cwe.description: The product constructs a string for a command to be executed by a separate component in another control sphere, but it does not properly delimit the intended arguments, options, or switches within that command string. When creating commands using interpolation into a string, developers may assume...
target_cwe.impact: code execution, data access, data modification
patterns: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: The shell interpolation allows argument delimiters to be interpreted as command separators, enabling arbitrary command execution.
